method: Signed-in Wix editor UI; rendered preview image alt, src, and parent data-image-info; originals downloaded directly from observed Wix asset identity. Converted to WebP at maximum 1600 pixels, preserving aspect ratio. No image generation or subject replacement.

assets.title: Straub Benioff Medical Center
assets.inspection: Visible building signage reads HAWAII PACIFIC HEALTH STRAUB MEDICAL CENTER; source heading and credit agree. No engineering narrative provided by the prototype.

assets.title: Temporary Schools for Maui
assets.inspection: Photograph shows a temporary modular classroom campus under construction. Title association comes from original Wix img alt. No more-specific project location, date, or engineering narrative verified.

assets.title: Ililani Condominium
assets.inspection: Wix associates this broad Kakaako skyline with Ililani, but the image contains multiple buildings and does not unambiguously identify the named project. Alternate Ilani Condo.png repeats the same skyline. Use a text-only under-construction entry rather than implying a verified building photo.

assets.title: Kaiāulu o Kūku’ia Apartments
assets.inspection: Image façade visibly reads KAHULUI LANI. The alternate kaiaulu Apartments.png is the same wrong subject. Another Kaiaulu.png has visible Kaiāulu o Kupuohi signage, also not the requested title. None is safe to display as Kaiāulu o Kūku’ia.

rejectedAlternates.reason: Building sign says Kaiāulu o Kupuohi.
Same broad skyline; named project not independently identifiable.

relatedExistingProject.evidence: Services (New) captions an existing project Palau Wharf Improvements, Malakal Island (2024).
